Treat url as untrusted input that may be absolute, contain query strings, or point to any host. The dangerous operation is opening and reading an HTTP response on the specified scheme and port. Accept only HTTP or HTTPS on their default ports and raise ValueError for every other scheme or port. Resolve the target hostname using resolve_host and follow at most five HTTP redirects; each Location header must be resolved against the current URL and must have the same scheme, port, credentials, and DNS/public-address as the initial destination, raising ValueError when no valid Location can be built. Check the scheme and port before creating the connection, capture the full response headers and body, and raise ValueError unless the status is exactly 200. Return the response body text for a successful request.
END_PLAN
